scope: minimal actual serving integration smoke, not an SLO sweep or final performance conclusion

selection.algorithm: sort each class by request_id; Random(42).sample 8 ShareGPT then 8 LongBench without replacement; shuffle the combined 16 using the same RNG

prompt_tokens.scope: frozen source-tokenizer counts; retain actual server prompt usage as well

warmup.rule: first occurrence of each source class in the fixed measurement order
warmup.scope: two real requests exercise prefill/decode before measured clients; does not establish complete shape warmup or continuous-power steady state

precision_scope: expert-only FP8 or calibrated AWQ sidecars; common BF16 host attention/router and verified common activation basis
phase_rule: real scheduler pure-prefill FP8, pure-decode AWQ; mixed threshold32 is an untuned mechanism setting; actual branch coverage must be checked from F7

budget.formula: 120 startup + (35 + 45 + 45) clients + 2 boundaries * 3 RPC methods * 2 seconds * 3 clients = 281; cleanup reserve 8 + 10 + 8 = 26
budget.scope: execution ceilings exclude lock waiting, CPU preflight/archive/hash/transfer; no automatic retry

measurement_accounting.startup_and_residency: group.json and gpu residency samples; startup and warmup excluded from per-client steady serving summaries
measurement_accounting.client_summaries: TTFT/TPOT P50/P95, successful throughput, finish reasons, all failures and unknown tokens; primary/counter/sampled gross/net J per generated token
measurement_accounting.energy_boundary: whole-device client arrival plus drain, after a separate 3 s idle baseline; includes Poisson gaps/load onset, not a continuous-load energy microbenchmark
measurement_accounting.F7: collective_rpc summary/take_records/reset before and after fully drained client; RPC time is outside the client latency/energy window
measurement_accounting.failure_rule: any incomplete, failed, timeout, or unknown-token population stops the server group; later runs are not_run; keep failure results
measurement_accounting.analysis_population: only measure_r01 and measure_r02; never glob warmup_excluded into measured repeats
measurement_accounting.limits: natural EOS can change output length/content across formats; report actual work and stop/cap/failure counts; two runs give a range, not a significance claim

validation.bench_serving_load_trace: passed both traces without importing torch or vLLM
validation.run_serving_group_full_plan: requires actual generated checkpoint/worker sidecars; no placeholders or mock artifacts used
